description: Angular component for inputting and managing SCADA symbols, including image resource handling, URL processing, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolInputComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing SCADA symbol input, including URL handling, image resource fetching, and dialog-based image selection.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, setting the URL and link type based on provided content and metadata.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Lifecycle hook for cleanup (empty in this implementation).

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the component and updates link type accordingly.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a new value to the component, processing URL and fetching image info if needed.

methods.name: detectLinkType
methods.description: Determines the link type based on the current URL.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the internal URL and propagates change to parent.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets link type and image resource.

methods.name: clearSymbol
methods.description: Clears the current symbol and resets the component.

methods.name: openGallery
methods.description: Opens image gallery dialog for selecting a new image resource.
